tool_input.command:
cd src/pixel && sed -i \
 -e "s/return p.sprite(HUE.amber, HUE.far);\n}/X/" sprites.ts && \
sed -i \
 -e '/export function waxWorks/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.amber, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.amber, HUE.violet);/' \
 -e '/export function woolMill/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.green, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.green, HUE.blue);/' \
 -e '/export function workBarn/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.orange, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.orange, HUE.pink);/' \
 -e '/export function forge/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.blue, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.blue, HUE.orange);/' \
 -e '/export function locksmith/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.amber, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.amber, HUE.teal);/' \
 -e '/export function milliner/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.violet, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.violet, HUE.teal);/' \
 -e '/export function postDepot/,/^}/ s/return p.sprite(HUE.blue, HUE.far);/return p.sprite(HUE.blue, HUE.orange);/' sprites.ts && \
sed -i \
 -e "s/S.poplar(40), x: 158/S.poplar(44), x: 158/" \
 -e "s/S.pine(40), x: 500/S.pine(44), x: 500/" \
 -e "s/S.poplar(40, HUE.green), x: 140/S.poplar(44, HUE.green), x: 140/" \
 -e "s/S.poplar(38), x: 142/S.poplar(44), x: 142/" \
 -e "s/S.pine(40, HUE.green), x: 498/S.pine(44, HUE.green), x: 498/" \
 -e "s/{ name: 'stools', s: S.stools(), x: 382, base: 116, d: D.stools }/{ name: 'coffee sacks', s: S.sacks(HUE.orange), x: 388, base: 116, d: D.sacks }/" scenes.ts && grep -c "HUE.far)" sprites.ts; grep -n "poplar(4\|pine(4\|coffee" scenes.ts
tool_input.description: Recolour lead roofs, raise verticals, swap stools
